workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: SSRF guard allows 100.64.0.0/10, including the Alibaba Cloud metadata address
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(utils): refuse non-global addresses in the outbound URL guard. Target files: src/langbot/pkg/utils/outbound_url.py, tests/unit_tests/utils/test_outbound_url_guard.py. `assert_safe_outbound_url` let the shared address space 100.64.0.0/10 through. That range holds the Alibaba Cloud metadata endpoint `100.100.100.200`. Python's `ipaddress` does not mark it private or reserved, so none of the existing checks in `_reject_reason` fired. Only `is_global` is False there. (Ref: https://github.com/langbot-app/LangBot/pull/3029)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: v4.11.7版本调用远程mcp工具解释报错
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(plugin): serialize call_tool results to JSON (#2999). Target files: src/langbot/pkg/plugin/handler.py, tests/unit_tests/api/test_execution_application_api.py. MCP tool loaders return `list[ContentElement]` (Pydantic models). `RuntimeConnectionHandler.call_tool` returned them as-is in both the Runner branch (`{'result': ...}`) and the plugin branch (`{'tool_response': ...}`). The Execution API then validates output as strict `JsonValue` and rejects it: `ActionCallError: Output does not match call_tool`. Only the platf... (Ref: https://github.com/langbot-app/LangBot/pull/3008)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: n8n runner ignores n8n's streaming "error" chunk, so a failed workflow is reported as completed (raw NDJSON or a half answer reaches the user)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(n8n): fail runs on streamed workflow errors. Target files: plugins/Runner/http-certification-tests/live_n8n_agent.py, plugins/Runner/n8n-agent/pkg/n8n_client.py, .github/workflows/daily-endurance.yml. n8n can return HTTP 200 and then stream a `type: error` chunk. The parser ignored that chunk, so the Runner sent raw NDJSON or finalized a partial answer and reported `run.completed`. (Ref: https://github.com/langbot-app/LangBot/pull/2994)
